ईर्म 1. ईर्म, ind., Ved. in this place, here,
to this place; (Sāy.) going constantly, or instigating
everything.

ईर्म 2. ईर्म, अस्, m., Ved. the arm, the fore-
quarter of an animal; (अम्), n. a sore or wound.

ईर्मान्त ईर्मान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. epithet of a
team of horses or of the horses of the sun's car; full-
haunched (lit. full-ended); thin-haunched; (perhaps)
having the biggest horses on both sides of the team.
